spotlight.title: This Month: Meenari
spotlight.intro: Once a month, we recognize one member for event participation, recruitment, guides, mentoring or member support.
body: This month recognizes Meenari for consistent answers, onboarding help & support during active guild hours.
They answer questions, onboard new members & direct members to the correct event, guide or support channel.
Their timely replies help recruitment, event preparation & member support continue during busy hours.
spotlight.conclusion: Thank you for the consistent support, useful answers & event participation that strengthen Mōchirīī.
